title: organization.export.ready.v1
description: The owner's full data export finished and its download link was opened (ADM-015, DataExportJob); subject = the export job. Ids and the archive size only; the link token never travels in an event. Consumers comms-gateway (the WhatsApp itself is comms.notification.requested.v1, purpose export_ready) and core/consent (compliance view): log-only handlers until they exist.

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
